subject: Middlebury Sophomore, Hungry to Learn
body:
Hi Alex,

I'm Max, 20, ambitious, curious about entrepreneurship, and a current Midd kid, so you sit on the board of my college. Leaving venture to write television for Fox, then coming back to co-found Spark, treats the detour as a credential.

I'm building an AI teaching assistant for Middlebury STEM courses. I'd love to know whether those years away made you a better judge of a founder, or only a better judge of a story.

If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max

subject: Middlebury Sophomore, Hungry to Learn
body:
Hi Scott,

Max here, 20, Middlebury sophomore building an AI teaching assistant.

Buying Windsurf in 72 hours, the weekend after Google took its founders, treats a collapse as a hiring window.

I'd love to know what you deliberately did not check in those three days.

10 minutes? I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max

subject: Middlebury Sophomore, Hungry to Learn
body:
Hi Ryan,

I'm Max, 20, ambitious, curious about entrepreneurship, and a current Midd kid. Handing Flexport to an Amazon executive and taking it back a year later is admitting in public that the hire was the mistake.

I'm building an AI teaching assistant and learning how founders decide when to reverse themselves. I'd love to know how long you knew before you acted, and what made you wait.

If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max
